w: In the evening assembly, a drama, 'Naiya Par', showed how Bhagatji Maharaj through his powers defused a life-threatening storm at sea and thus saved Ganpatbhai of Bharuch and Jethabhai Patel of Pij. Swamishri, in his blessings, appreciated the drama and said, "If one has refuge in God and His Sadhu then whatever difficulty arises, God protects in some way. But one must have faith and trust… Life in this world is like a camel ride. It is also compared with the vast ocean wherein one experiences both happiness and misery…"
Today's Gunatit Din was dedicated to the life and works of Aksharbrahma Gunatitanand Swami.

The evening assembly was centered around Gunatitanand Swami's Yash Gatha. Sadhus sang one verse depicting Gunatitanand Swami's glory, after which this verse was explained by a drama, a speech or a presentation.

Swamishri also described Gunatitanand Swami's qualities in his blessings to the assembly, narrating various incidents, such as, Gunatitanand Swami's transformation of the notorious Munjo Suru. He stressed the fact that Bhagwan Swaminarayan came on earth together with his divine abode in the form of Gunatitanand Swami.
